content.meta: Grand Indonesia Tower B · 1,200 bays · ANPR · guidance
content.summary: Grand Indonesia Tower B — 1,200 bays upgraded with ANPR entry, parking guidance and cashless exit, live in 10 weeks without closing the basement.
content.challenge: Ticket-based entry created 15-minute exit queues at weekday peaks, and the operator had no live view of occupancy across four basement levels.
content.solution: We replaced ticket dispensers with ANPR cameras at 6 entry lanes, added bay-level guidance displays and installed QRIS / e-money exit kiosks — phased lane by lane so the basement never closed.
content.outcome: Exit queues fell by 62%, revenue reconciliation is automatic, and tenants now see live availability on the building app.

content.quote: We went cashless without closing a single level. Our tenants noticed the difference in the first week.
content.author: Yudi Prasetyo
content.role: Building Manager, Grand Indonesia Tower B

content.summary: 48 flap lanes with face recognition across library, faculty buildings and dormitories — one identity for 32,000 students.
content.challenge: Shared student cards were passed between friends, and the library had no reliable visitor count.
content.solution: Face recognition terminals on every flap lane, synced with the academic system, plus Library Management for loans and occupancy.
content.outcome: Card sharing stopped overnight, and the library now reports live occupancy to the campus app.

content.summary: Tripod turnstiles with QR and app check-in at 22 clubs, connected to Gym Management for memberships and billing.
content.challenge: Front desks spent peak hours checking cards by hand, and expired members slipped in unnoticed.
content.solution: QR and app check-in at tripod turnstiles, with membership status checked in real time by Entragate Gym Management.
content.outcome: Check-in takes under 4 seconds and renewal reminders are sent automatically at the gate.

content.summary: 96 tripod lanes validating e-tickets for 40,000 fans, with live capacity per gate for the control room.
content.challenge: Paper tickets were forged, and gates had no live count — the control room learned about overcrowding from the stands.
content.solution: E-Ticketing with dynamic QR passes validated at outdoor-rated tripod turnstiles, and a live capacity dashboard per gate.
content.outcome: Forgery disappeared, and the stadium fills in 35 minutes with operators steering crowds between gates.

content.meta: Bank Sentosa HQ · Kiosk · speed gates · VMS
content.summary: Self-service visitor kiosks and speed gates for a 30-floor bank headquarters, with host notifications and audit trails.
content.challenge: Reception queues stretched into the lobby, and compliance needed a complete audit trail for every visitor.
content.solution: Visitor Management with pre-registration, self-service kiosks and QR passes that open the swing gates only for the floor being visited.
content.outcome: Lobby queues are gone and auditors receive monthly visitor reports automatically.

content.meta: Graha Tower Phase 2 · 12 swing gates · Access Cloud
content.summary: 12 glass swing gates managed from Entragate Access Cloud, sharing one tenant directory with Phase 1.
content.challenge: Phase 2 needed premium lobby gates that worked with the existing Phase 1 tenant cards.
content.solution: Tempered-glass swing gates on Access Cloud, importing the Phase 1 directory so tenants use one credential across both towers.
content.outcome: Tenants moved into Phase 2 without re-issuing a single card.

content.meta: Graha Nusantara · 24 swing lanes · 8,500 daily entries
content.summary: A 24-lane smart lobby with swing barriers, face recognition and visitor management for 8,500 daily entries.
content.challenge: Morning peaks overwhelmed the old turnstiles and guards checked visitor passes by hand.
content.solution: 24 swing lanes with face recognition for tenants and QR passes for visitors, all managed from one dashboard.
content.outcome: Average entry time dropped to 3.1 seconds, even at 8:00 peak.

content.meta: Flap barriers + visitor management for 3 hospital wings
content.summary: Flap barriers and visitor management across 3 hospital wings, with visiting-hour rules per ward.
content.challenge: Wards were crowded outside visiting hours and staff couldn't enforce visitor limits.
content.solution: Visitor passes tied to each patient, enforced at flap barriers per wing, with a fire-alarm override for emergencies.
content.outcome: Visitor limits are enforced automatically, and nurses no longer police the corridors.

content.meta: 18 boom barriers with LPR and cashless payment across 4 levels
content.summary: 18 boom barriers with LPR and cashless payment across 4 levels.
content.challenge: Cash handling at exits caused long weekend queues and reconciliation errors.
content.solution: LPR-based entry, cashless exit kiosks and Smart Parking software reconciling every transaction.
content.outcome: Weekend exit queues disappeared and daily reconciliation is automatic.

content.meta: City hall · 16 flap lanes · public service queue
content.summary: Flap barriers, visitor kiosks and staff face recognition for a city hall serving 3,000 citizens a day.
content.challenge: Citizens and staff shared one entrance, with no record of who entered secure floors.
content.solution: Separate staff lanes with face recognition and a visitor kiosk issuing QR passes for public-service floors — TKDN-certified hardware.
content.outcome: Secure floors are restricted to staff, and every public visit is logged.

The terminal stores 50,000 faces on device, works with masks and safety helmets, and mounts on every Entragate gate or as a standalone wall reader.
Pre-orders are open now, with first deliveries scheduled for the third week of November.

title: Going cashless in your car park without closing a level

content.excerpt: Lessons from migrating 1,200 bays to ANPR entry and QRIS exit at Grand Indonesia Tower B.
body: Cashless parking cuts exit queues and removes cash handling, but many operators worry about the disruption of switching over.
At Grand Indonesia Tower B we migrated one lane at a time, running ANPR in parallel with existing ticket dispensers until every lane was live — the basement never closed.
Exit queue times fell by 62%, and revenue now reconciles automatically each night.

title: Entragate barrier gates are now TKDN certified

content.excerpt: Locally assembled gates qualify for government and BUMN procurement under local-content rules.
body: Swing, flap and tripod gates assembled at our Bekasi workshop are now registered under Indonesia's TKDN local-content program.
Government agencies and state-owned enterprises can now procure Entragate gates through e-Katalog with local-content credit.

title: A visitor management checklist for office towers

content.excerpt: Eight things to decide before you replace the lobby logbook.
body: Start with who visits: contractors, guests, couriers and interview candidates all need different flows.
Decide whether hosts must pre-register guests, how IDs are verified, which floors passes open and how long data is kept.
Finally, plan for peaks — self-service kiosks and QR passes keep the lobby moving at 8:00.

content.summary: Follow every stage of your order with the order number from your confirmation email.

Open Track Order and enter the order number from your confirmation email or invoice together with the phone number or email used at checkout. The page refreshes every 30 minutes.
Business customers can see every order without an order number in the Customer Portal, including invoices, Faktur Pajak and installation schedules.

content.summary: Ready-stock lead times for Jabodetabek and other provinces.
body: Stocked models (swing barriers, flap barriers, tripod turnstiles) ship within 5 business days in Jabodetabek and 7–10 days to other provinces.
Pre-order models are produced in 3–4 weeks. Express delivery (1–2 working days) and same-day warehouse pickup in Bekasi are available at checkout.
All freight is insured. Large orders can be split across several sites — add each address to your quotation request.

content.summary: What to do if a unit arrives damaged or you need to return it.
body: Inspect the crates on delivery and note any visible damage on the courier's receipt.
Report damage within 48 hours from the Customer Portal or by WhatsApp with photos of the crate and the unit. We replace damaged units at no cost.
Unopened ready-stock items can be returned within 14 days; custom finishes and project orders are non-returnable.

content.summary: Get volume pricing, installation and a site survey in one quotation.
body: Add products to your request from the catalog or Build Your Solution, then complete the project details on the RFQ page.
Our sales engineers reply within one working day with a quotation PDF, which you can approve in the Customer Portal.
Projects of four lanes or more qualify for volume pricing of up to 12%.

title: Getting a Faktur Pajak for your purchase

content.summary: How tax invoices are issued for business customers.
body: Enable “Issue Faktur Pajak” at checkout and enter your company NPWP. For quotations, add the NPWP to your company profile in the Customer Portal.
The Faktur Pajak is issued within 3 working days of full payment and is available to download from the Customer Portal.

content.summary: Virtual accounts, QRIS, cards and credit terms for business accounts.
body: We accept BCA and Mandiri virtual accounts, QRIS, and Visa, Mastercard and JCB cards. Virtual-account payments are verified instantly.
Business accounts can apply for NET 14 invoice terms, subject to credit approval.

content.summary: What our engineers check and how to prepare your site.
body: Surveys are free in Jabodetabek and take 1–2 hours per entrance group. Our engineer measures lanes, power, network and cable routes.
Please prepare floor plans, the number of users or daily visitors, and contact details for building management.
You receive a survey report and updated quotation within 2 working days.

content.summary: Power, network and civil works needed before our team arrives.
body: Each lane needs a 220V outlet on a dedicated MCB and a CAT6 network point. Floors must be level within 3 mm.
Conduits from the control room to each lane should be in place. Our team handles core drilling and anchoring.
Installation usually takes 1–3 days per entrance group, followed by commissioning and operator training.

content.summary: Two-year warranty on parts and labour, with options to extend.
body: Entragate hardware carries a two-year warranty on parts, components and on-site labour within Jabodetabek, plus lifetime firmware updates.
Damage from power surges or vandalism is not covered, but can be added with an optional protection plan.
Extend coverage to five years from the Customer Portal or your account manager.

content.summary: Open a claim in minutes from the Customer Portal.
body: Register your device first by scanning the QR label in the Customer Portal.
Open the device, choose “Claim warranty”, describe the issue and attach photos or videos. Urgent tickets receive a reply within one hour.

content.summary: Bulk-enrol staff and members from photos or the member app.
body: Upload a CSV with photos, or invite people to self-enrol from the member app. Enrolled faces sync to every terminal within a minute.
Liveness detection rejects photos of photos and screens, so self-enrolment is safe for members and visitors.

title: Integrating with HR and membership systems

content.summary: Use the REST API and webhooks to sync people and events.
body: Entragate exposes a documented REST API and webhooks for people, credentials and access events.
Common integrations include HRIS (Talenta, Mekari), membership and billing systems, and payment gateways. Our engineers can build the connector for you.

title: Inviting team members and setting roles

content.summary: Approvers, finance and viewers on one company account.
body: Business accounts can invite colleagues from Company & team in the Customer Portal.
Approvers can accept quotations, Finance sees invoices and payments, and Viewers can track orders and tickets.

content.summary: Passwords, sign-in alerts and removing access for leavers.
body: Use a password of at least 12 characters. You receive an email whenever your account signs in from a new device.
Remove leavers from Company & team — their sessions end immediately.

items.question: How long does delivery and installation take?
items.answer: Stocked models (swing barriers, flap barriers, tripod turnstiles) ship within 5 business days in Jabodetabek and 7–10 days to other provinces. Installation is scheduled after the site survey and usually takes 1–3 days per entrance group. You can follow every step in Order Tracking.

items.question: Can I get a Faktur Pajak for my purchase?
items.answer: Yes. Enable “Issue Faktur Pajak” at checkout or add your NPWP to your company profile. It is issued within 3 working days of full payment.

items.question: What does the standard warranty cover?
items.answer: Two years on parts, components and on-site labour within Jabodetabek, plus lifetime firmware updates. Power-surge and vandalism damage can be covered with an optional plan.

items.question: How do I raise a support ticket?
items.answer: Open a ticket in the Customer Portal under Support → New ticket, or WhatsApp our 24/7 line. Attach photos or videos so our engineers can diagnose remotely.

items.question: Can multiple people from my company use one account?
items.answer: Yes. Business accounts can invite approvers, finance staff and viewers, each with their own login and permissions.

items.question: Does Entragate integrate with our existing HR or membership system?
items.answer: Yes — through our REST API and webhooks. We regularly integrate with HRIS, membership, billing and payment systems, and can build the connector for you.

items.question: Do you offer site surveys outside Jakarta?
items.answer: Yes. Surveys are free in Jabodetabek; elsewhere our Surabaya, Medan and Makassar teams survey sites for a travel fee that is deducted from your order.

items.question: Can I deliver to several sites in one order?
items.answer: Yes — add each site to your quotation request and we split delivery and installation per site.

items.question: Can I pick up from your warehouse?
items.answer: Yes, choose Warehouse pickup at checkout to collect from Bekasi on the same day.

items.question: What if my delivery arrives damaged?
items.answer: Report it within 48 hours with photos and we replace the damaged unit at no cost.

items.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: BCA and Mandiri virtual accounts, QRIS, Visa, Mastercard and JCB. Business accounts can apply for NET 14 invoices.

items.question: Do prices include PPN?
items.answer: Catalog prices exclude PPN 11%, which is added at checkout and on quotations.

items.question: Can we pay with a down payment?
items.answer: Project orders use milestone payments — typically 50% down payment, with the balance due before shipping.

items.question: How do I register my device?
items.answer: Scan the QR label on the device in the Customer Portal to activate its warranty.

items.question: Do you offer maintenance contracts?
items.answer: Yes. Preventive maintenance plans include scheduled visits, priority response and discounted spare parts.

items.question: How fast do you respond to urgent faults?
items.answer: Urgent tickets receive a first reply within one hour, and on-site response within 24 hours in Jabodetabek.

items.question: Is the software cloud or on-premise?
items.answer: Both. Entragate Cloud is hosted in Indonesian data centres; on-premise servers are available for government and high-security sites.

items.question: Does the gate still work if the internet is down?
items.answer: Yes. Controllers store credentials and events locally and sync when the connection returns.

items.question: Is there a member or staff app?
items.answer: Yes — the Entragate app provides QR passes, face enrolment and visitor invites on Android and iOS.
